description.zh: DSW实例ID，填写此项用于查找与该实例绑定的UserCommand。传入该选项会覆盖UserCommandId的设置。
description.en: The ID of the Data Science Workshop (DSW) instance. Specify this parameter to find the user command that is attached to the instance. This parameter overwrites the UserCommandId setting.
The token used to access the user command. The token is issued by the GetToken API operation.

description.zh: 用户自定义命令的ID。可通过GetInstance等接口获取。
description.en: The ID of the user-defined command. You can get this ID by calling API operations such as GetInstance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun pai-dsw get-user-command --user-command-id 1900 --instance-id dsw-dlsd0fskn193213xxx --token eyJhbGci...... --api-version 2022-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
